title: Random HTTP 500 Error Spike
description: 30% of all data-plane requests fail with HTTP 500. Errors are thrown early in the request handler before any DB query, so latency is unaffected.

true_root_cause.summary: error_spike=true with error_spike_rate=0.3 — random 500 errors injected at 30% probability per request

key_evidence_signals.expected_behaviour: Rate spikes to ~30% of total request rate; error_type=server_error
Unchanged — errors return quickly before any work is done
Ratio may drop slightly because errored requests skip DB queries
Stable — no CPU burn injected in this scenario

recommended_fix: Identify the upstream dependency or code path throwing 500s; check Loki error logs for exception details
evaluation_checks: Agent identifies error_spike as the active flag
Agent cites http_errors_total as primary evidence
Agent notes latency is unaffected (errors are pre-DB)
